~~~~~file path=observability/test/observability.test.mjs
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { breakdown, runCost } from '../lib/costs.mjs';
import { loadConfig, langfuseUrl } from '../lib/config.mjs';
import { LangfuseExporter } from '../lib/langfuse.mjs';
import { toOtlp } from '../lib/otlp.mjs';
import { TraceStore } from '../lib/store.mjs';
import { nodeFor, overlay } from '../lib/topology.mjs';
import { Tracer, parseClaudeStream, recordClaudeRun } from '../lib/trace.mjs';
import { usageReport } from '../lib/usage.mjs';
import { createViewer } from '../viewer/server.mjs';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const TOPO = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(HERE, '..', 'topology.json'), 'utf8'));
const tmp = () => mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'obs-'));
const USAGE = { input_tokens: 12, output_tokens: 3253, cache_read_input_tokens: 72347, cache_creation_input_tokens: 21865,
  cache_creation: { ephemeral_1h_input_tokens: 21865, ephemeral_5m_input_tokens: 0 } };

async function sampleTrace(dir) {
  const tracer = new Tracer(dir);
  let id;
  await tracer.run('chat', 'user', 'hi', async (t) => {
    id = t.id;
    t.span('trigger', '사용자 메시지', { input: 'hi' });
    const llm = t.span('llm', 'claude -p', { meta: { model: 'm', effort: 'low', cost_usd: 0.4373, usage: USAGE, turns: 13, resumed: true } });
    t.span('tool', 'mcp__app__get_profile', { parent: llm });
    t.span('tool', 'WebSearch', { parent: llm, input: { query: 'q' } });
    t.span('tool', 'Write', { parent: llm, status: 'error', error: 'No such tool available: Write' });
  });
  return id;
}

test('비용 분할의 합은 청구액과 같고, 1시간 캐시 쓰기가 가장 크다', () => {
  const parts = breakdown(USAGE, 0.4373);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(parts.reduce((t, p) => t + p.usd, 0) - 0.4373) < 1e-9);
  assert.deepEqual(parts.map((p) => p.key), ['cache_write', 'output', 'cache_read', 'input']);
  assert.deepEqual(breakdown({}, 0.1), []);
  assert.deepEqual(breakdown(USAGE, null), []);
  const c = runCost([{ meta: { cost_usd: 0.4373, usage: USAGE, turns: 13, resumed: true } }]);
  assert.equal(c.turns, 13); assert.equal(c.resumed, true); assert.equal(c.parts[0].key, 'cache_write');
});

test('trace 파일: 끝나면 가장 나쁜 span 상태가 trace 상태가 된다', async () => {
  const dir = tmp();
  const id = await sampleTrace(dir);
  const d = new TraceStore(dir).get(id);
  assert.equal(d.trace.status, 'error');
  assert.equal(d.spans.length, 5);
  assert.equal(d.spans[3].parent_id, d.spans[1].id);
  assert.ok(d.trace.ended_at);
});

test('예외는 error span으로 남고 다시 던져진다. onEnd 실패는 무시한다', async () => {
  const dir = tmp();
  const tracer = new Tracer(dir, { onEnd: () => { throw new Error('lf down'); } });
  await assert.rejects(tracer.run('job', 'schedule', null, () => { throw new TypeError('boom'); }), /boom/);
  const [t] = new TraceStore(dir).list();
  assert.equal(t.status, 'error');
  assert.match(t.error, /TypeError: boom/);
});

test('claude stream-json: 도구 오류와 payload 오류를 잡는다', () => {
  const raw = [
    { type: 'system', subtype: 'init', session_id: 'S', model: 'm', mcp_servers: [{ name: 'app', status: 'failed' }] },
    { type: 'assistant', message: { content: [{ type: 'tool_use', id: 'a', name: 'Write', input: {} }, { type: 'tool_use', id: 'b', name: 'mcp__app__save', input: {} }] } },
    { type: 'user', message: { content: [{ type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: 'a', is_error: true, content: '<tool_use_error>No such tool</tool_use_error>' },
      { type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: 'b', content: [{ type: 'text', text: '{"saved": false, "violations": ["3~4개"]}' }] }] } },
    { type: 'result', result: 'ok', session_id: 'S', is_error: false, total_cost_usd: 0.1, num_turns: 3, usage: { output_tokens: 5 } },
  ].map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n');
  const p = parseClaudeStream(raw);
  assert.equal(p.is_error, false); assert.equal(p.turns, 3);
  assert.equal(p.tools[0].error, 'No such tool');
  assert.match(p.tools[1].error, /규칙 위반: 3~4개/);
  assert.equal(parseClaudeStream('garbage').error, 'no result event');
  const dir = tmp();
  const tracer = new Tracer(dir);
  return tracer.run('chat', 'user', null, (t) => {
    recordClaudeRun(t, p, { prompt: 'x', effort: 'low' });
    const kinds = t.data.spans.map((s) => s.kind);
    assert.deepEqual(kinds, ['llm', 'check', 'tool', 'tool']);
    assert.ok(t.data.spans.slice(2).every((s) => s.started_at >= t.data.spans[0].started_at));
  });
});

test('OTLP: 비용·캐시 토큰을 명시하고 채팅 id는 보내지 않는다', async () => {
  const dir = tmp();
  const id = await sampleTrace(dir);
  const d = new TraceStore(dir).get(id);
  d.trace.chat_id = 12345;
  d.trace.change = 'CHG-0007';
  const body = toOtlp(d, { serviceName: 'svc' });
  const spans = body.resourceSpans[0].scopeSpans[0].spans;
  const attrs = (s) => Object.fromEntries(s.attributes.map((a) => [a.key, a.value.stringValue]));
  const llm = attrs(spans[2]);
  assert.equal(llm['langfuse.observation.type'], 'generation');
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(llm['langfuse.observation.cost_details']), { total: 0.4373 });
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(llm['langfuse.observation.usage_details']).cache_read_input_tokens, 72347);
  assert.equal(spans[5].status.code, 2);
  assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(body).includes('12345'));
  assert.equal(spans[3].parentSpanId, spans[2].spanId);
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(attrs(spans[0])['langfuse.trace.tags']), ['user', 'error', 'CHG-0007']);
});

test('Langfuse 전송: 성공하면 전송됨, 실패하면 다음에 재시도', async () => {
  const dir = tmp();
  const id = await sampleTrace(dir);
  const store = new TraceStore(dir);
  const lf = { host: 'http://lf', publicKey: 'pk', secretKey: 'sk', projectId: 'p' };
  const calls = [];
  const down = new LangfuseExporter(lf, store, { fetchImpl: async () => ({ ok: false, status: 503, text: async () => 'down' }) });
  assert.equal(await down.flush(), 0);
  assert.deepEqual(store.unexported(), [id]);
  const up = new LangfuseExporter(lf, store, { fetchImpl: async (url, init) => { calls.push([url, init]); return { ok: true }; } });
  assert.equal(await up.flush(), 1);
  assert.equal(calls[0][0], 'http://lf/api/public/otel/v1/traces');
  assert.match(calls[0][1].headers.authorization, /^Basic /);
  assert.deepEqual(store.unexported(), []);
});

test('Langfuse 키가 없으면 꺼진 상태(null)로 동작한다', () => {
  const root = tmp();
  assert.equal(loadConfig(root, {}).langfuse, null);
  writeFileSync(path.join(root, '.env'), 'LANGFUSE_HOST=http://localhost:3000/\nLANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk\nLANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY="sk"\nLANGFUSE_PROJECT_ID=p\n');
  const lf = loadConfig(root, {}).langfuse;
  assert.equal(lf.host, 'http://localhost:3000'); assert.equal(lf.secretKey, 'sk');
  assert.equal(langfuseUrl(lf, 'abc'), 'http://localhost:3000/project/p/traces/abc');
});

test('구성도: span이 노드에 붙고 via 노드는 경로상 거침, Langfuse는 설정에 따라 꺼짐', async () => {
  const dir = tmp();
  const id = await sampleTrace(dir);
  const d = new TraceStore(dir).get(id);
  assert.equal(nodeFor(TOPO, { kind: 'tool', name: 'mcp__app__get_profile' }, d.trace), 't.read');
  assert.equal(nodeFor(TOPO, { kind: 'tool', name: 'Write' }, d.trace), 'builtin');
  assert.equal(nodeFor(TOPO, { kind: 'trigger', name: 'x' }, { trigger: 'schedule' }), 'trig.schedule');
  const ov = overlay(TOPO, d, { langfuse: false });
  assert.equal(ov.st.builtin.status, 'error');
  assert.ok(ov.st.app && ov.st.mcp && ov.st.store && ov.st.config);
  assert.equal(ov.st.config.note, 'm · low');
  assert.ok(ov.disabled.has('lf'));
  const ids = new Set(TOPO.nodes.map((n) => n.id));
  for (const [a, b] of TOPO.edges) assert.ok(ids.has(a) && ids.has(b), `edge ${a}->${b}`);
});

test('사용 현황: 도구별 사용·오류, 작업별 비용, 스킬 목록', async () => {
  const root = tmp();
  const dir = path.join(root, 'traces');
  await sampleTrace(dir);
  const skills = path.join(root, 'agent', 'skills', 'plan');
  (await import('node:fs')).mkdirSync(skills, { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(path.join(skills, 'SKILL.md'), '---\nname: plan\ndescription: 계획을 짠다\n---\n');
  const u = usageReport(new TraceStore(dir), { days: 30, skillDirs: [path.join(root, 'agent', 'skills')] });
  assert.deepEqual(u.skills.map((s) => [s.name, s.uses]), [['plan', 0]]);
  assert.equal(u.tools.find((t) => t.name === 'Write').errors, 1);
  assert.equal(u.cost_by_job[0].job, 'chat');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(u.cost_by_job[0].usd - 0.4373) < 1e-9);
});

test('뷰어 서버: 목록·상세(비용 포함)·구성도·정적 파일, 쓰기와 경로 조작은 거부', async () => {
  const root = tmp();
  const id = await sampleTrace(path.join(root, 'traces'));
  const srv = createViewer(loadConfig(root, {}));
  await new Promise((r) => srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${srv.address().port}`;
  try {
    const list = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/traces`)).json();
    assert.equal(list[0].id, id); assert.equal(list[0].error_count, 1); assert.equal(list[0].langfuse_url, null);
    const d = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/traces/${id}`)).json();
    assert.equal(d.first_error_seq, 5); assert.equal(d.cost.parts[0].key, 'cache_write');
    assert.equal((await (await fetch(`${base}/api/config`)).json()).langfuse, false);
    assert.ok((await (await fetch(`${base}/api/topology`)).json()).nodes.length > 5);
    for (const p of ['/', '/usage', '/static/flow.js', '/lib/topology.mjs']) assert.equal((await fetch(base + p)).status, 200, p);
    assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/static/../../.env`)).status, 404);
    assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/api/traces/nothex`)).status, 404);
    assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/api/traces`, { method: 'POST' })).status, 405);
  } finally { srv.close(); }
});

~~~~~file path=observability/viewer/flow.js
// 에이전트 흐름 화면: 실행 목록 → 토폴로지 / 순서도(스윔레인) → 단계 상세.
import { laneFor, nodeFor } from '/lib/topology.mjs';
import { renderTopology, setup } from '/static/topology.js';

const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
const api = (p) => fetch(p).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error(`${p} → ${r.status}`))));
const STATUS = { ok: ['정상', 'ok'], warn: ['경고', 'warn'], error: ['오류', 'err'], running: ['실행 중', ''] };
const time = (iso) => new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
const hm = (iso) => new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
const day = (iso) => new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('ko-KR', { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
const ms = (a, b) => (a && b ? Math.max(0, Date.parse(b) - Date.parse(a)) : null);
const dur = (v) => (v == null ? '' : v < 1000 ? `${v}ms` : `${(v / 1000).toFixed(1)}초`);
const parse = (s) => { try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch { return null; } };
const worst = (xs) => (xs.includes('error') ? 'error' : xs.includes('warn') ? 'warn' : 'ok');

let TOPO, LANES, LANE_IDX;
const state = { status: '', detail: null, rows: [], cur: 0 };

/** 단계 한 줄의 담당 열·이름·요약. 도구 이름은 구성도 노드 이름으로 바꿔 보여 준다. */
function describe(s, trace) {
  const lane = laneFor(TOPO, s, trace);
  const node = TOPO.nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeFor(TOPO, s, trace));
  const input = parse(s.input) || {};
  if (s.kind === 'llm') {
    const m = s.meta || {};
    return { lane, role: '워커가 생각하고 답을 씀', detail: [m.model, m.effort, dur(m.duration_ms ?? ms(s.started_at, s.ended_at)), m.cost_usd != null ? `$${Number(m.cost_usd).toFixed(2)}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') };
  }
  if (s.kind === 'tool') {
    const short = s.name.replace(/^mcp__[^_]+__/, '');
    const first = typeof input === 'object' ? Object.values(input).find((v) => typeof v === 'string') : '';
    return { lane, role: `${short}${node && node.id !== 't.other' ? ` · ${node.name}` : ''}`, detail: s.status === 'error' ? s.error : first || '',
      verb: lane === 'write' ? 'write' : '' };
  }
  return { lane, role: s.name, detail: s.status === 'error' ? s.error : (s.output || s.input || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ') };
}

function buildRows(detail) {
  const rows = [];
  for (const s of [...detail.spans].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)) {
    const d = describe(s, detail.trace);
    const last = rows.at(-1);
    if (last && s.kind === 'tool' && last.kind === 'tool' && last.name === s.name) {
      last.items.push(s); last.details.push(d.detail); last.status = worst(last.items.map((x) => x.status));
      continue;
    }
    rows.push({ kind: s.kind, name: s.name, items: [s], details: [d.detail], status: s.status, ...d });
  }
  return rows;
}

function renderGraph() {
  const { trace, spans } = state.detail;
  const rows = state.rows;
  const wi = LANE_IDX.worker ?? 1;
  const firstW = rows.findIndex((r) => r.lane === 'worker');
  const lastTool = rows.reduce((acc, r, i) => (['tool', 'check', 'output'].includes(r.kind) ? i : acc), firstW);
  const g = $('#graph');
  g.style.setProperty('--lanes', LANES.length);
  let html = LANES.map((l, i) => `<div class="lane-head" style="grid-column:${i + 1};grid-row:1"><b>${esc(l.name)}</b><span>${esc(l.desc)}</span></div>`).join('');
  html += LANES.map((_, i) => `<div class="lane-bg ${i % 2 ? 'alt' : ''}" style="grid-column:${i + 1};grid-row:2 / span ${Math.max(rows.length, 1)}"></div>`).join('');
  if (firstW >= 0 && lastTool > firstW) html += `<div class="spine" style="grid-column:${wi + 1};grid-row:${firstW + 2} / ${lastTool + 3}"></div>`;
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const li = LANE_IDX[r.lane] ?? wi;
    let from = null;
    if (['tool', 'check', 'output'].includes(r.kind)) from = wi;
    else if (r.kind === 'llm' && i > 0) from = LANE_IDX[rows[i - 1].lane] ?? wi;
    if (from != null && from !== li) {
      const a = Math.min(from, li), b = Math.max(from, li);
      html += `<div class="link ${li > from ? 'right' : 'left'} ${r.status === 'ok' ? '' : r.status}" style="grid-column:${a + 1} / ${b + 2};grid-row:${i + 2};--span:${b - a + 1}"></div>`;
    }
    const count = r.items.length > 1 ? ` <span class="count">×${r.items.length}</span>` : '';
    const detail = r.items.length > 1 ? r.details.filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).join(' · ') + (r.items.length > 2 ? ' …' : '') : r.details[0];
    html += `<button type="button" class="step ${r.status === 'ok' ? '' : r.status} ${r.verb === 'write' ? 'write' : ''}" data-i="${i}"
      data-lane="${esc(LANES[li]?.name || '')}" style="grid-column:${li + 1};grid-row:${i + 2}" aria-pressed="${i === state.cur}"
      aria-label="${i + 1}번째. ${esc(r.role)}. ${STATUS[r.status]?.[0] || ''}">
      <span class="num">${i + 1}</span><span class="role">${esc(r.role)}${count}</span><span class="detail">${esc(detail || ' ')}</span></button>`;
  });
  g.classList.remove('dense');
  g.style.gridTemplateRows = `auto repeat(${rows.length}, minmax(44px, auto))`;
  g.innerHTML = html;
  if (document.documentElement.scrollHeight > window.innerHeight + 4) { g.classList.add('dense'); g.style.gridTemplateRows = `auto repeat(${rows.length}, minmax(34px, auto))`; }
  g.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => select(+b.dataset.i)));

  const phases = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    const label = LANES[LANE_IDX[r.lane] ?? wi]?.name || r.lane;
    const p = phases.at(-1);
    if (p && p.label === label) { p.count += r.items.length; p.status = worst([p.status, r.status]); }
    else phases.push({ label, count: r.items.length, status: r.status, first: rows.indexOf(r) });
  }
  $('#phases').innerHTML = phases.map((p) => `<button type="button" class="phase ${p.status === 'ok' ? '' : p.status}" data-i="${p.first}">${esc(p.label)}${p.count > 1 ? ` <b>${p.count}</b>` : ''}${p.status === 'error' ? ' · 오류' : ''}</button>`).join('<span class="arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>');
  $('#phases').querySelectorAll('.phase').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => select(+b.dataset.i)));

  const errs = spans.filter((s) => s.status === 'error').length;
  $('#graph-h').textContent = `${trace.name} · ${trace.trigger}`;
  $('#graph-sub').textContent = `${day(trace.started_at)} ${time(trace.started_at)} · 단계 ${spans.length}개${errs ? ` · 오류 ${errs}` : ''} · ${dur(ms(trace.started_at, trace.ended_at))}`;
  const fe = rows.findIndex((r) => r.status === 'error');
  if (fe >= 0) {
    const e = rows[fe].items.find((x) => x.status === 'error');
    $('#cause').hidden = false;
    $('#cause').innerHTML = `<b>${fe + 1}번째 단계 · ${esc(rows[fe].role)}에서 오류</b> · ${esc((e.error || '').slice(0, 160))} <button type="button" id="jump">그 단계 보기</button>`;
    $('#jump').addEventListener('click', () => { setView('seq'); select(fe); });
  } else if (trace.status === 'error') {
    $('#cause').hidden = false; $('#cause').textContent = `실행 전체가 실패했어요: ${trace.error || ''}`;
  } else $('#cause').hidden = true;
}

function renderInspector() {
  const r = state.rows[state.cur];
  const tr = state.detail.trace;
  if (!r) { $('#inspector').innerHTML = '<p class="muted">이 실행에는 기록된 단계가 없어요.</p>'; return; }
  const [label, cls] = STATUS[r.status] || [r.status, ''];
  const block = (t, b, x = '') => (b ? `<div class="block ${x}"><span>${t}</span><pre>${esc(b)}</pre></div>` : '');
  const lane = LANES[LANE_IDX[r.lane]] || { name: r.lane };
  let body;
  if (r.items.length > 1) {
    body = `<ol class="calls">${r.items.map((s, k) => `<li class="${s.status === 'error' ? 'err' : ''}"><b>${k + 1}.</b> ${esc(r.details[k] || s.input || '')}${s.status === 'error' ? `<div class="e">${esc(s.error)}</div>` : ''}</li>`).join('')}</ol>${block('마지막 결과', r.items.at(-1).output)}`;
  } else {
    const s = r.items[0], m = s.meta || {};
    const kv = [['누가', lane.name], ['시각', time(s.started_at)], ['걸린 시간', dur(m.duration_ms ?? ms(s.started_at, s.ended_at)) || '–']];
    if (s.kind === 'llm') {
      kv.push(['모델', `${m.model || '?'} · ${m.effort || '?'}`]);
      if (m.usage) kv.push(['토큰', `입력 ${m.usage.input_tokens ?? '?'} · 출력 ${m.usage.output_tokens ?? '?'} · 캐시 읽기 ${m.usage.cache_read_input_tokens ?? 0} · 캐시 쓰기 ${m.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens ?? 0}`]);
      if (m.cost_usd != null) kv.push(['비용', `$${Number(m.cost_usd).toFixed(3)}`]);
      if (m.turns != null) kv.push(['턴', m.turns]);
    }
    if (s.kind === 'tool') kv.push(['도구', s.name]);
    body = `<dl class="kv">${kv.map(([k, v]) => `<dt>${k}</dt><dd>${esc(v)}</dd>`).join('')}</dl>${block('오류', s.error, 'err')}${block('입력', s.input)}${block('결과', s.output)}`;
  }
  const lf = /^https?:\/\//.test(tr.langfuse_url || '') ? esc(tr.langfuse_url) : '';
  $('#inspector').innerHTML = `
    <span class="muted small">${state.cur + 1} / ${state.rows.length}번째 단계 · ${esc(lane.name)}</span>
    <h3>${esc(r.role)}${r.items.length > 1 ? ` ×${r.items.length}` : ''}</h3>
    <span class="badge ${cls}" style="align-self:flex-start">${label}</span>${body}
    ${lf ? `<a href="${lf}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Langfuse에서 이 실행 열기 ↗</a>` : '<span class="muted small">Langfuse 미연결 · 로컬 기록만 보여요</span>'}`;
}

function select(i) {
  if (!state.rows.length) return;
  state.cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(state.rows.length - 1, i));
  document.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(+b.dataset.i === state.cur)));
  document.querySelector(`.step[data-i="${state.cur}"]`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
  renderInspector();
}

function setView(v) {
  document.body.dataset.view = v;
  $('#tab-topo').setAttribute('aria-selected', String(v === 'topo'));
  $('#tab-seq').setAttribute('aria-selected', String(v === 'seq'));
  showView();
}

function showView() {
  if (!state.detail) return;
  renderGraph();
  if (document.body.dataset.view === 'seq') renderInspector(); else renderTopology(state.detail);
}

async function openTrace(id) {
  state.detail = await api(`/api/traces/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
  state.rows = buildRows(state.detail);
  const fe = state.rows.findIndex((r) => r.status === 'error');
  state.cur = fe >= 0 ? fe : 0;
  history.replaceState(null, '', `/?trace=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
  document.querySelectorAll('.run').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-current', String(b.dataset.id === id)));
  showView();
}

async function loadRuns(preferId) {
  const traces = await api(`/api/traces${state.status ? `?status=${state.status}` : ''}`);
  $('#runs').innerHTML = traces.length ? traces.map((t) => {
    const s = t.status === 'error' ? `<span class="s err">오류 ${t.error_count || ''}</span>`
      : t.status === 'warn' ? `<span class="s warn">경고 ${t.warn_count}</span>` : `<span class="s">${t.status === 'running' ? '실행 중' : '정상'} · 단계 ${t.span_count}</span>`;
    return `<li><button type="button" class="run" data-id="${esc(t.id)}" aria-current="false" title="${esc(t.input || '')}">
      <span class="t">${day(t.started_at)} ${hm(t.started_at)} · ${esc(t.name)}</span>${s}</button></li>`;
  }).join('') : '<li class="empty-state muted">아직 기록된 실행이 없어요. 에이전트가 traces/에 기록을 남기면 여기에 보여요.</li>';
  $('#runs').querySelectorAll('.run').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => openTrace(b.dataset.id).catch(showError)));
  const want = preferId && traces.find((t) => t.id === preferId) ? preferId : (traces.find((t) => t.status === 'error') || traces[0] || {}).id;
  if (want) await openTrace(want);
}

function showError(e) { $('#cause').hidden = false; $('#cause').textContent = `불러오지 못했어요: ${e.message}`; }

async function main() {
  const [topo, cfg] = await Promise.all([api('/api/topology'), api('/api/config')]);
  TOPO = topo; LANES = topo.lanes; LANE_IDX = Object.fromEntries(LANES.map((l, i) => [l.key, i]));
  setup(topo, cfg);
  document.querySelectorAll('.chip[data-status]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.chip[data-status]').forEach((x) => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(x === b)));
    state.status = b.dataset.status;
    loadRuns().catch(showError);
  }));
  $('#tab-topo').addEventListener('click', () => setView('topo'));
  $('#tab-seq').addEventListener('click', () => setView('seq'));
  $('#prev').addEventListener('click', () => select(state.cur - 1));
  $('#next').addEventListener('click', () => select(state.cur + 1));
  $('#graph').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const d = ['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight'].includes(e.key) ? 1 : ['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft'].includes(e.key) ? -1 : 0;
    if (!d) return;
    e.preventDefault(); select(state.cur + d); document.querySelector(`.step[data-i="${state.cur}"]`)?.focus();
  });
  await loadRuns(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('trace'));
}
main().catch(showError);

~~~~~file path=observability/viewer/server.mjs
// 실행 기록 뷰어. 의존성 없음. 사용: node observability/viewer/server.mjs  →  http://127.0.0.1:8790
// 읽기 전용(GET만). 기본으로 이 컴퓨터(127.0.0.1)에만 열린다. 휴대폰 등에서 보려면 VIEWER.md의 원격 접속 절.
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { loadConfig, langfuseUrl } from '../lib/config.mjs';
import { runCost } from '../lib/costs.mjs';
import { TraceStore } from '../lib/store.mjs';
import { usageReport } from '../lib/usage.mjs';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const OBS = path.dirname(HERE);
// 열어 주는 파일은 이 목록뿐(경로 조작 방지)
const FILES = {
  '/': ['index.html', 'text/html'], '/usage': ['usage.html', 'text/html'],
  '/static/viewer.css': ['viewer.css', 'text/css'], '/static/flow.js': ['flow.js', 'text/javascript'],
  '/static/topology.js': ['topology.js', 'text/javascript'], '/static/usage.js': ['usage.js', 'text/javascript'],
  '/lib/topology.mjs': ['../lib/topology.mjs', 'text/javascript'],
};

export function createViewer(cfg = loadConfig(), { topologyFile = path.join(OBS, 'topology.json') } = {}) {
  const store = new TraceStore(cfg.tracesDir);
  const skillDirs = [path.join(cfg.root, 'agent', 'skills'), path.join(cfg.root, '.claude', 'skills')];
  const withLink = (t) => ({ ...t, langfuse_url: langfuseUrl(cfg.langfuse, t.id), chat_id: undefined });

  const api = {
    '/api/config': () => ({ langfuse: Boolean(cfg.langfuse), langfuse_host: cfg.langfuse?.host || null }),
    '/api/topology': () => JSON.parse(readFileSync(topologyFile, 'utf8')),
    '/api/traces': (q) => store.list({ status: q.get('status') || undefined, limit: Math.min(Number(q.get('limit')) || 50, 200) }).map(withLink),
    '/api/usage': (q) => usageReport(store, { days: Math.min(Math.max(Number(q.get('days')) || 30, 1), 365), skillDirs }),
  };

  return createServer((req, res) => {
    const send = (code, body, type = 'application/json') => {
      res.writeHead(code, { 'content-type': `${type}; charset=utf-8`, 'cache-control': 'no-store', 'x-content-type-options': 'nosniff' });
      res.end(type === 'application/json' ? JSON.stringify(body) : body);
    };
    try {
      if (req.method !== 'GET') return send(405, { error: 'read-only' });
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
      if (FILES[url.pathname]) {
        const [file, type] = FILES[url.pathname];
        return send(200, readFileSync(path.join(HERE, file)), type);
      }
      if (api[url.pathname]) return send(200, api[url.pathname](url.searchParams));
      const m = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/traces\/([0-9a-f]{32})$/);
      if (m) {
        const d = store.get(m[1]);
        if (!d) return send(404, { error: 'trace not found' });
        const first = d.spans.find((s) => s.status === 'error');
        return send(200, { trace: withLink(d.trace), spans: d.spans, first_error_seq: first ? first.seq : null,
          cost: runCost(d.spans.filter((s) => s.kind === 'llm')) });
      }
      return send(404, { error: 'not found' });
    } catch (e) {
      return send(500, { error: e.message });
    }
  });
}

if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const cfg = loadConfig();
  createViewer(cfg).listen(cfg.viewerPort, cfg.viewerHost, () => {
    console.log(`trace viewer: http://${cfg.viewerHost}:${cfg.viewerPort}  (traces: ${cfg.tracesDir}, Langfuse: ${cfg.langfuse ? cfg.langfuse.host : '꺼짐'})`);
  });
}

~~~~~file path=observability/viewer/topology.js
// 토폴로지 보기: 에이전트 전체를 고정된 지도로 그리고, 고른 실행이 쓴 부분에 불을 켠다.
// 지도는 observability/topology.json. 마우스 휠은 페이지 스크롤에 양보하고, 확대·축소는 버튼으로만 한다.
import { overlay } from '/lib/topology.mjs';

const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
const NW = 200, NH = 104;
const X = (c) => 40 + c * 250, Y = (r) => 56 + r * 160;
const ICON = {
  trigger: '<path d="M4 4h16v12H8l-4 4z"/>',
  clock: '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/><path d="M12 8v4l3 2"/>',
  gate: '<path d="M12 3l8 3v6c0 4.5-3.4 8-8 9-4.6-1-8-4.5-8-9V6z"/>',
  bot: '<rect x="4" y="7" width="16" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M12 3v4M9 12h.01M15 12h.01"/>',
  brain: '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M5 5l2 2M17 17l2 2M5 19l2-2M17 7l2-2"/>',
  config: '<path d="M4 6h10M18 6h2M4 12h4M12 12h8M4 18h12"/><circle cx="16" cy="6" r="2"/><circle cx="10" cy="12" r="2"/><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="2"/>',
  plug: '<path d="M9 7V3M15 7V3M7 7h10v4a5 5 0 0 1-10 0zM12 16v5"/>',
  read: '<path d="M2 12s4-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-4 7-10 7S2 12 2 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>',
  write: '<path d="M4 20h4L19 9l-4-4L4 16z"/>',
  web: '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3 3 15 0 18M12 3c-3 3-3 15 0 18"/>',
  db: '<ellipse cx="12" cy="5" rx="8" ry="3"/><path d="M4 5v14c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3V5M4 12c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3"/>',
  send: '<path d="M3 11l18-8-8 18-2-8z"/>',
  chart: '<path d="M4 20V10M10 20V4M16 20v-7M22 20H2"/>',
  block: '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M5.6 5.6l12.8 12.8"/>',
};
const STATUS = { ok: ['완료', 'ok'], error: ['실패', 'err'], warn: ['경고', 'warn'] };
const PART_COLOR = { cache_write: '#C2410C', output: '#1F5FAD', cache_read: '#8A8A84', input: '#D4D4CE' };

let TOPO = null, BY_ID = {}, cfg = { langfuse: false };
let view = { k: 1, x: 0, y: 0 }, current = null, selected = null, ov = null;
const pos = (n) => ({ x: X(n.c), y: Y(n.r) });
const size = () => ({ W: X(Math.max(...TOPO.nodes.map((n) => n.c)) + 1) + 20, H: Y(Math.max(...TOPO.nodes.map((n) => n.r)) + 1) + 20 });

export function setup(topology, config) {
  TOPO = topology; cfg = config;
  BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(TOPO.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const host = document.getElementById('topo-canvas');
  let drag = null;
  host.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest('.topo-node')) return;
    drag = { x: e.clientX - view.x, y: e.clientY - view.y };
    host.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    host.classList.add('grabbing');
  });
  host.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => { if (drag) { view.x = e.clientX - drag.x; view.y = e.clientY - drag.y; applyView(); } });
  host.addEventListener('pointerup', () => { drag = null; host.classList.remove('grabbing'); });
  document.getElementById('topo-in').addEventListener('click', () => zoom(1.2));
  document.getElementById('topo-out').addEventListener('click', () => zoom(1 / 1.2));
  document.getElementById('topo-fit').addEventListener('click', fit);
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => current && fit());
}

function edgePath(a, b, mode, ax = 0.5, bx = 0.5) {
  const pa = pos(a), pb = pos(b);
  const sx = pa.x + NW * ax, tx = pb.x + NW * bx;
  if (mode === 'R') { const y = pa.y + NH / 2; return [`M ${pa.x + NW} ${y} L ${pb.x - 6} ${y}`, (pa.x + NW + pb.x) / 2, y - 10]; }
  if (mode === 'D') {
    const gy = pb.y - 42;
    if (Math.abs(sx - tx) < 1) return [`M ${sx} ${pa.y + NH} L ${tx} ${pb.y - 6}`, tx + 22, (pa.y + NH + pb.y) / 2];
    return [`M ${sx} ${pa.y + NH} L ${sx} ${gy} L ${tx} ${gy} L ${tx} ${pb.y - 6}`, tx, gy + 14];
  }
  if (mode === 'L') { const y = pb.y + NH / 2; return [`M ${sx} ${pa.y + NH} L ${sx} ${y} L ${pb.x - 6} ${y}`, (sx + pb.x) / 2, y - 10]; }
  if (mode === 'T') { const gy = Math.min(pa.y, pb.y) - 26; return [`M ${sx} ${pa.y} L ${sx} ${gy} L ${tx} ${gy} L ${tx} ${pb.y - 6}`, (sx + tx) / 2, gy - 9]; }
  if (mode === 'U') { const gy = pa.y + NH + 14; return [`M ${sx} ${pa.y + NH} L ${sx} ${gy} L ${tx} ${gy} L ${tx} ${pb.y + NH + 6}`, (sx + tx) / 2, gy - 9]; }
  return [`M ${pa.x + NW} ${pa.y} L ${pb.x} ${pb.y}`, 0, 0];
}

function render() {
  const host = document.getElementById('topo-canvas');
  const { W, H } = size();
  let html = `<div class="topo-world" id="topo-world" style="width:${W}px;height:${H}px">`;
  for (const g of TOPO.groups || []) {
    const r1 = g.r1 ?? g.r0;
    html += `<div class="topo-group" style="left:${X(g.c0) - 16}px;top:${Y(g.r0) - 28}px;width:${X(g.c1) - X(g.c0) + NW + 32}px;height:${Y(r1) - Y(g.r0) + NH + 44}px"><span>${esc(g.label)}</span></div>`;
  }
  html += `<svg class="topo-edges" width="${W}px" height="${H}px" aria-hidden="true"><defs>
    <marker id="ta-on" orient="auto" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="6" refY="4"><path d="M0 0 L8 4 L0 8Z" fill="#3F3F3B"/></marker>
    <marker id="ta-off" orient="auto" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="6" refY="4"><path d="M0 0 L8 4 L0 8Z" fill="#C9C9C2"/></marker>
    <marker id="ta-err" orient="auto" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="6" refY="4"><path d="M0 0 L8 4 L0 8Z" fill="#D8473A"/></marker></defs>`;
  const labels = [];
  for (const [a, b, label, mode, ax, bx, onIf] of TOPO.edges) {
    if (!BY_ID[a] || !BY_ID[b]) continue;
    const used = (id) => ov && ov.st[id];
    const on = Boolean(ov && (onIf ? used(onIf) : used(a) && used(b)));
    const err = on && ov.st[b]?.status === 'error';
    const [d, lx, ly] = edgePath(BY_ID[a], BY_ID[b], mode, ax, bx);
    html += `<path d="${d}" class="${err ? 'err' : on ? 'on' : 'off'}" marker-end="url(#${err ? 'ta-err' : on ? 'ta-on' : 'ta-off'})"/>`;
    if (label) labels.push(`<span class="topo-elabel ${on ? 'on' : ''}" style="left:${lx}px;top:${ly - 8}px">${esc(label)}</span>`);
  }
  html += `</svg>${labels.join('')}`;
  for (const n of TOPO.nodes) {
    const p = pos(n), o = ov?.st[n.id], dis = ov?.disabled.has(n.id);
    const [label, cls] = o ? STATUS[o.status] : dis ? ['꺼짐', 'off'] : ['미사용', 'idle'];
    const k = o ? o.calls.length : 0;
    const secs = (v) => (v < 1000 ? `${v}ms` : `${(v / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`);
    const metric = !o ? '—' : o.calls.some((s) => s.kind === 'llm')
      ? `${o.calls.reduce((t, s) => t + (s.meta?.usage?.output_tokens || 0), 0)} tok · ${secs(o.ms)}`
      : k > 1 ? `×${k} · ${secs(o.ms)}` : k === 1 ? secs(o.ms) : (o.note || '✓');
    const sub = o?.status === 'error' ? (o.calls.find((s) => s.status === 'error')?.error || '실패') : o?.note || n.role;
    html += `<button type="button" class="topo-node ${cls} ${selected === n.id ? 'sel' : ''}" data-id="${esc(n.id)}" style="left:${p.x}px;top:${p.y}px"
      aria-label="${esc(n.name)}: ${label}. ${esc(n.role)}">
      <span class="tn-head"><span class="tn-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${ICON[n.icon] || ICON.plug}</svg></span>
        <span class="tn-status ${cls}"><i></i>${label}</span></span>
      <span class="tn-name">${esc(n.name)}</span>
      <span class="tn-sub">${esc(o ? sub : n.role)}</span>
      <span class="tn-foot"><span class="tn-ns">${esc(n.ns || n.id)}</span><span class="tn-metric">${esc(metric)}</span></span>
    </button>`;
  }
  host.innerHTML = `${html}</div>`;
  host.querySelectorAll('.topo-node').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); select(b.dataset.id); }));
  applyView();
  renderStrip();
}

function applyView() { const w = document.getElementById('topo-world'); if (w) w.style.transform = `translate(${view.x}px, ${view.y}px) scale(${view.k})`; }
function fit() {
  const host = document.getElementById('topo-canvas');
  const { W, H } = size();
  const k = Math.min(host.clientWidth / W, host.clientHeight / H, 1.2);
  view = { k, x: (host.clientWidth - W * k) / 2, y: (host.clientHeight - H * k) / 2 };
  applyView();
}
function zoom(f) {
  const host = document.getElementById('topo-canvas');
  const cx = host.clientWidth / 2, cy = host.clientHeight / 2;
  const k = Math.max(0.3, Math.min(2.5, view.k * f));
  view.x = cx - (cx - view.x) * (k / view.k); view.y = cy - (cy - view.y) * (k / view.k); view.k = k;
  applyView();
}

const usd = (v) => `$${v >= 0.1 ? v.toFixed(2) : v.toFixed(3)}`;
function renderStrip() {
  const el = document.getElementById('topo-strip');
  const vals = TOPO.nodes.map((n) => (ov.st[n.id] ? ov.st[n.id].status : ov.disabled.has(n.id) ? 'off' : 'idle'));
  const c = (k) => vals.filter((v) => v === k).length;
  const cost = current.cost?.total || 0;
  const t = current.trace;
  const total = t.ended_at ? (Date.parse(t.ended_at) - Date.parse(t.started_at)) / 1000 : null;
  el.innerHTML = [
    ['완료', c('ok'), 'ok'], ['실패', c('error'), c('error') ? 'err' : ''], ['미사용', c('idle'), ''],
    ['걸린 시간', total == null ? '–' : `${total.toFixed(1)}초`, ''], ['비용', cost ? usd(cost) : '–', ''],
    ['Langfuse', cfg.langfuse ? (t.exported ? '전송됨' : '대기') : '꺼짐', ''],
  ].map(([k, v, cls]) => (k === '비용' && cost
    ? `<button type="button" class="ts-cell ts-btn" id="cost-btn" title="비용 내역 보기"><span>${k} · 내역 보기</span><b>${v}</b></button>`
    : `<div class="ts-cell ${cls}"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}</b></div>`)).join('');
  document.getElementById('cost-btn')?.addEventListener('click', showCost);
}

export function showCost() {
  const c = current?.cost;
  if (!c || !c.total) return;
  selected = null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.topo-node').forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('sel'));
  const why = [];
  if (c.parts[0]?.key === 'cache_write') why.push('가장 큰 몫은 캐시에 새로 올린 내용이에요. 지시문과 이전 대화가 길수록, 1시간 캐시를 쓸수록 커져요.');
  if (c.resumed) why.push('이 실행은 앞 대화를 이어받았어요(resume). 캐시가 만료된 뒤라면 대화 기록 전체를 다시 캐시에 써요.');
  if (c.turns > 6) why.push(`모델이 ${c.turns}번 오갔어요. 도구를 부를 때마다 앞 내용 전체를 다시 읽어서 읽기 비용이 쌓여요.`);
  if (c.thinking_tokens) why.push(`생각(thinking)에 ${c.thinking_tokens.toLocaleString()} 토큰을 썼어요. 출력 가격으로 계산돼요.`);
  document.getElementById('inspector').innerHTML = `
    <span class="muted small">이 실행의 비용</span>
    <h3>${usd(c.total)}</h3>
    <div class="cost-stack" role="img" aria-label="${esc(c.parts.map((p) => `${p.label} ${Math.round(p.share * 100)}%`).join(', '))}">
      ${c.parts.map((p) => `<span style="width:${p.share * 100}%;background:${PART_COLOR[p.key]}"></span>`).join('')}</div>
    <ol class="cost-parts">${c.parts.map((p) => `<li><span class="sw" style="background:${PART_COLOR[p.key]}"></span>
      <div><b>${esc(p.label)}</b> <span class="muted small">${p.tokens.toLocaleString()} 토큰</span><div class="muted small">${esc(p.hint)}</div></div>
      <b class="amt">${usd(p.usd)}<span class="muted small"> ${Math.round(p.share * 100)}%</span></b></li>`).join('')}</ol>
    ${why.length ? `<dl class="kv"><dt>왜 이만큼</dt><dd>${why.map(esc).join('<br>')}</dd></dl>` : ''}
    <p class="muted small">모델이 알려 준 실제 청구액을 토큰 종류별 가격 비율로 나눈 값이에요. 기간별 합계는 <a href="/usage">스킬·도구·비용</a>에서 봐요.</p>`;
}

function select(id) {
  selected = id;
  document.querySelectorAll('.topo-node').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('sel', b.dataset.id === id));
  const n = BY_ID[id], o = ov?.st[id];
  const block = (t, b) => (b ? `<div class="block"><span>${t}</span><pre>${esc(b)}</pre></div>` : '');
  const [label, cls] = o ? STATUS[o.status] : ov?.disabled.has(id) ? ['꺼짐', ''] : ['미사용', ''];
  const calls = o?.calls || [];
  const lf = current?.trace.langfuse_url;
  document.getElementById('inspector').innerHTML = `
    <span class="muted small">${esc(n.ns || n.id)}</span>
    <h3>${esc(n.name)}</h3>
    <span class="badge ${cls}" style="align-self:flex-start">${label}</span>
    <dl class="kv"><dt>하는 일</dt><dd>${esc(n.role)}</dd>${o?.note ? `<dt>이번 실행</dt><dd>${esc(o.note)}</dd>` : ''}
      <dt>호출</dt><dd>${calls.length ? `${calls.length}회` : o ? '기록 없음 (경로상 거침)' : '0회'}</dd></dl>
    ${calls.length ? `<ol class="calls">${calls.map((s, k) => `<li class="${s.status === 'error' ? 'err' : ''}"><b>${k + 1}.</b> ${esc((s.input || s.name || '').slice(0, 160))}
      ${s.status === 'error' ? `<div class="e">${esc(s.error)}</div>` : ''}</li>`).join('')}</ol>`
    : o ? '<p class="muted small">이번 실행이 이 부분을 지나갔어요. 여기는 따로 호출 기록이 남지 않는 단계라, 앞뒤 단계를 보고 거쳤다고 표시했어요.</p>'
      : '<p class="muted small">이번 실행에서는 이 부분을 쓰지 않았어요 (미사용).</p>'}
    ${calls.length === 1 ? block('결과', calls[0].output) : ''}
    ${lf && /^https?:\/\//.test(lf) ? `<a href="${esc(lf)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Langfuse에서 이 실행 전체 보기 ↗</a>` : ''}`;
}

export function renderTopology(detail) {
  current = detail;
  ov = overlay(TOPO, detail, { langfuse: cfg.langfuse });
  const firstErr = TOPO.nodes.find((n) => ov.st[n.id]?.status === 'error');
  selected = firstErr ? firstErr.id : (TOPO.nodes.find((n) => ov.st[n.id]?.calls.some((s) => s.kind === 'llm'))?.id || TOPO.nodes[0].id);
  render();
  fit();
  select(selected);
}

~~~~~file path=observability/viewer/usage.js
// 스킬·도구·비용 화면. 데이터: /api/usage?days=N (observability/lib/usage.mjs)
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
const PART_COLOR = { cache_write: '#C2410C', output: '#1F5FAD', cache_read: '#8A8A84', input: '#D4D4CE' };
const usd = (v) => `$${v >= 0.1 ? v.toFixed(2) : v.toFixed(3)}`;
const ago = (iso) => { if (!iso) return '–'; const d = (Date.now() - Date.parse(iso)) / 864e5; return d < 1 ? '오늘' : `${Math.floor(d)}일 전`; };

function costBlock(d) {
  const all = d.cost_by_job, total = all.reduce((t, j) => t + j.usd, 0);
  document.getElementById('cost-total').textContent = total ? `최근 ${d.days}일 합계 ${usd(total)}` : '';
  if (!total) return '<p class="muted">이 기간에 비용이 기록된 모델 호출이 없어요. llm span의 meta.cost_usd·usage를 남기면 여기에 나와요.</p>';
  const parts = {};
  for (const j of all) for (const p of j.parts) { const q = (parts[p.key] ||= { ...p, usd: 0, tokens: 0 }); q.usd += p.usd; q.tokens += p.tokens; }
  const ps = Object.values(parts).sort((a, b) => b.usd - a.usd);
  const pct = (v) => Math.round((v / total) * 100);
  return `
    <h3 class="small muted" style="margin:0">무엇에 쓰였나</h3>
    <div class="stack" role="img" aria-label="${esc(ps.map((p) => `${p.label} ${pct(p.usd)}%`).join(', '))}">${ps.map((p) => `<span style="width:${(p.usd / total) * 100}%;background:${PART_COLOR[p.key]}"></span>`).join('')}</div>
    <table class="cap-table"><tbody>${ps.map((p) => `<tr><td><span class="sw" style="background:${PART_COLOR[p.key]}"></span> <b>${esc(p.label)}</b><div class="muted small">${esc(p.hint)}</div></td>
      <td class="num">${p.tokens.toLocaleString()} 토큰</td><td class="num"><b>${usd(p.usd)}</b> · ${pct(p.usd)}%</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>
    <h3 class="small muted" style="margin:8px 0 0">어떤 작업에 쓰였나</h3>
    <table class="cap-table"><tbody>${all.map((j) => `<tr><td>${esc(j.job)}</td><td class="num">${j.runs}회</td><td class="num">회당 ${usd(j.usd / j.runs)}</td><td class="num"><b>${usd(j.usd)}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>
    <p class="muted small" style="margin:0">모델이 알려 준 실제 청구액을 토큰 종류별 가격 비율로 나눈 값이에요. 실행 하나의 내역은 에이전트 흐름에서 비용 칸을 눌러 봐요.</p>`;
}

function skillsBlock(d) {
  document.getElementById('skills-sub').textContent = `${d.skills.length}개 보유`;
  if (!d.skills.length) return '<div class="empty"><b>아직 스킬이 없어요</b><span class="muted small">agent/skills/&lt;이름&gt;/SKILL.md 또는 .claude/skills/에 두면 여기에 나와요. 사용 횟수는 실행 기록의 "Skill" 도구 호출로 셉니다.</span></div>';
  return `<table class="cap-table"><thead><tr><th>스킬</th><th>하는 일</th><th>위치</th><th class="num">사용</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${d.skills.map((s) => `<tr class="${s.uses ? '' : 'unused'}"><td class="cap-name">${esc(s.name)}</td><td>${esc(s.description)}</td><td class="muted small">${esc(s.source)}</td><td class="num">${s.uses}회</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
}

function toolsBlock(d) {
  document.getElementById('tools-sub').textContent = `${d.tools.length}개 사용 (최근 ${d.days}일)`;
  if (!d.tools.length) return '<tbody><tr><td class="muted">이 기간에 도구 호출 기록이 없어요.</td></tr></tbody>';
  const max = Math.max(1, ...d.tools.map((t) => t.uses));
  return `<thead><tr><th>도구</th><th class="num">사용</th><th class="num">오류</th><th class="num">마지막</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${d.tools.map((t) => `<tr><td class="cap-name">${esc(t.name)}</td><td class="num"><span class="usebar" style="width:${(t.uses / max) * 60}px"></span>${t.uses}</td>
      <td class="num ${t.errors ? 'err-n' : ''}">${t.errors || '–'}</td><td class="num">${ago(t.last_used)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody>`;
}

async function load(days) {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-days]').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.days === String(days))));
  const d = await (await fetch(`/api/usage?days=${days}`)).json();
  document.getElementById('cost').innerHTML = costBlock(d);
  document.getElementById('skills').innerHTML = skillsBlock(d);
  document.getElementById('tools').innerHTML = toolsBlock(d);
}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-days]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => load(b.dataset.days)));
load(30);

~~~~~file path=ops/changes/REGISTRY.md
# Change Registry

> Change Record 한 건에 한 줄. 최신이 위. 상세는 각 `CHG-####.md`.

| ID | 날짜 | 계기 | 대상 | 전 → 후 | 결정 | KI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
~~~~~

~~~~~file path=ops/changes/_TEMPLATE.md
---
id: CHG-0000
status: proposed          # proposed | adopted | rejected | rolled-back
date: null                # YYYY-MM-DD
author: human             # human | agent
trigger: []               # ISS-####, KI ID, P-####
targets: []               # agent/ 경로
eval_suite: smoke         # smoke | full
eval_before: null         # evals/results/<run-id>.json
eval_after: null
knowledge: []             # 이 변경에서 추출한 KI ID
---
## 가설
<무엇을 바꾸면 어떤 케이스·점수가 어떻게 달라질 것인가. 하나만 적는다.>

## Prior Knowledge
<knowledge/dev/에서 찾은 관련 KI ID. 없으면 없음.>

## 변경 내용
<바꾼 것을 대상 경로별로 요약.>

## 평가 결과
| Suite | 전 | 후 | 비고 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

- 목표 Eval Case: <ID와 통과 여부>
- Regression: <떨어진 케이스 ID 또는 없음>

## 부작용
<함께 나빠진 것, 비용·지연 변화.>

## 결정과 이유
<adopted / rejected / rolled-back 중 무엇으로 닫았고 왜인가.>
~~~~~

~~~~~

~~~~~file path=ops/issues/_TEMPLATE.md
---
id: ISS-0000
status: open              # open | fixed | wontfix
date: null                # YYYY-MM-DD
stage: retrieval          # intent | retrieval | analysis | other
tags: []
eval_case: []             # 이 실패를 재현하는 Eval Case ID (fixed면 필수)
change: []                # 이 이슈를 다룬 CHG ID (fixed면 필수)
failure_mode: null        # 해당하면 FM ID
---
## 무엇이 틀렸나
<요청, 에이전트의 결과, 기대한 결과.>

## 어디서 틀렸나
<목적 파악 / 조회 / 분석 중 어느 단계인가. 트레이스 위치.>

## 재현
<재현 방법. 등록한 Eval Case ID.>
